insight.headline: Order Update Taxes
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for unfulfilled orders. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and applies to API version 2026-10 and later. The order's taxes are recalculated against the new destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their code to handle the new tax calculation behavior when updating shipping addresses. This change may impact apps that use the orderUpdate mutation, such as those that handle order fulfillment or shipping. Developers should review their code and test it with the updated API to ensure compatibility. They can use the GraphQL Admin API to test the new behavior and verify that taxes are calculated correctly.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations when updating shipping addresses for unfulfilled orders, which can help prevent errors and ensure compliance with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures that merchants comply with tax regulations. It also provides a better experience for customers by ensuring that they are charged the correct amount of tax.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and extends the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts. Additionally, @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.3 and @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.1 patches improve local debugger connections and reliability.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. The `createdAt` field is also now available on the Customer object in Shopify Functions.

themes.title: Ecosystem and App Updates
themes.detail: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps better reflect how fulfillment operations run in practice. The Shopify CLI version 4.6.0 removes deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching.
